init.description: Gas conversion uses m³ × 1.02264 × calorific value ÷ 3.6. Enter your bill value (37–43), or 0 to keep native volume. Converted gas kWh and costs are estimates. Converted gas recalculates the configured history window on every update; other tariff changes recalculate 14 days. Older records outside these windows remain unchanged.
